name: Operations Management
original_description: Explore the strategic planning and execution of an organization's core production and service delivery processes. Dive into forecasting demand, managing inventory, optimizing workflows, and leveraging data analytics to drive operational efficiency. Gain hands-on experience with process mapping, capacity planning, and quality control techniques to streamline operations and minimize waste.
new_description: Learn the core principles, theories, and analytical methods of operations management, including supply chain design, process improvement, quality control, inventory optimization, and production planning. Examine how organizations can strategically manage their operations to enhance efficiency, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
focus_areas: supply chain management, process optimization, quality systems, inventory control, production planning

name: Finance
original_description: Explore the intricate world of finance, where you'll delve into the nuances of investment vehicles, portfolio optimization, and risk management strategies. Uncover the power of compound interest, learn to navigate complex financial statements, and master the art of financial planning to achieve your long-term goals. From the basics of budgeting and banking to the intricacies of derivatives and hedging, this dynamic field will equip you with the analytical tools and decision-making skills needed to navigate the ever-evolving financial landscape.
new_description: Learn core financial concepts and analytical methods for evaluating investment opportunities, assessing risk, and managing capital. Examine principles of portfolio theory, market dynamics, and financial modeling to understand how to make informed decisions in a complex economic environment.
focus_areas: investment analysis, risk assessment, portfolio theory, market dynamics, capital management

name: Business Fundamentals
original_description: Delve into the core principles of business operations, from the fundamentals of accounting and finance to the strategic management of organizations. Explore the intricacies of marketing strategies, supply chain logistics, and human resource management. Gain insights into the legal and ethical considerations that shape modern business practices, and learn how to navigate the complexities of entrepreneurship and small business development. Through case studies and hands-on simulations, you'll develop the analytical and decision-making skills needed to thrive in a dynamic, competitive marketplace.
new_description: Discover the foundational principles, theories, and analytical methods that underpin the world of business. Examine core concepts in economics, organizational behavior, and management that shape how companies operate, make decisions, and achieve their objectives.
focus_areas: microeconomics, macroeconomics, organizational structure, leadership and management, financial accounting
